note: execution: 'coinbase' = real orders through broker_coinbase.py when a key is present (retail Advanced Trade by default, Coinbase Exchange when COINBASE_API_PASSPHRASE is set), shadow ledger on the same public data when it is not | 'ledger' = shadow only | 'alpaca' = Alpaca paper. Live orders also require live_ack: true, min_grade_before_live graded outcomes, and a cycle heartbeat younger than max_gap_h. Per-trade live risk = min(sizer, live_max_risk, equity*live_max_risk_frac); if the notional that needs exceeds max_notional_frac of equity the trade is SKIPPED, never quietly trimmed. fees = what the venue charges per side, charged on every fill (paper and live) and netted into the R that grading uses; a live trade whose round-trip fee exceeds live_max_fee_r of its own risk is REFUSED, and live_max_fee_r: 0 turns that guard off. See README 'The wallet' and 'Going live'.
